m8-a11.note: The backend was SIGTERMed and restarted 116 s before the period closed. Three users received a digest for that period and the maximum per user was 1, with no duplicate. An explicit `snapback4 run digest.daily` re-run of the same period afterwards still left exactly 1. Because the grader's worker performs no deduplication, a genuine double emit would have appeared as two entries with distinct meta ids. digestMarkers is unique on (principal, periodEnd) and the job inserts a marker even when it emits nothing.

m8-a12.note: Five messages were sent into a group the target is not a member of; the target's digest still reported unreadChats 1 and unreadMessages 2 - the outsider traffic contributed nothing. The actual member of that group received his own separate digest. Source: the job iterates only members[p.principal] and unreadIn excludes tombstoned rows; expired rows no longer exist.

m8-a17.note: Native durable-queue-across-restart proof. No admissible artifact exists. simulator.md requires a booted iOS simulator running the installed build plus m8-ios-screen.mp4, schema-valid m8-ios-receipts.jsonl and m8-ios-run.json; the lane produced none of these, passed no --simulator-status to the harness, and its artifacts/mN-ios directories are `expo export` Hermes bundles (README states this plainly). The lane's own cold-offline probes are labelled platform:"web", restart:"page reload offline" and are builder assertions on the web carrier, which the frozen prompt excludes as a basis for simulator assertions. The precondition (an installed native app on a simulator) therefore never existed. m8-a17 specifically requires observing the queued bodies after the app process was terminated and relaunched while still offline; simulator.md states that a screenshot taken before process termination cannot satisfy it.
